chapters.title: BUY-SIDE POOL · MAJOR
chapters.text: Price reverses three average ranges off the high at 26,656.00, and the tool maps a buy-side pool there, ranked MAJOR (its top rank for how long an extreme stood). Odds of a trade there within 60 bars: 56%.

chapters.title: POOL TURNS HOT
chapters.text: Price works back toward the high. The pool now reads 69% to be reached within 60 bars: 28.25 pts away against a one-hour reach of ±65.71. It turns HOT.

chapters.title: SWEPT ▼ · MAJOR
chapters.text: A bar trades through 26,656.00 and the next close is back below it: SWEPT. The double chevron and H mark the hunt on price, and the pool's band ends on a bright stop.
